description.value: Kuma Sushi is the sushi arm of Jack's Place, a casual full-service patio restaurant situated at Bear Mountain resort in Langford. The combined venue offers an unusually eclectic menu spanning hand-rolled sushi, wood-fired pizza, pub appetizers, and craft cocktails — all available for lunch and dinner. Its resort-community setting and relaxed patio atmosphere make it a comfortable meal stop for cyclists exploring the Bear Mountain area.

address.value: 2020 Country Club Way, Langford, BC V9B 6R3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Kuma Sushi' but its URL points to jacksplacebearmountain.ca, the website for 'Jack's Place' — a full-service restaurant that incorporates Kuma Sushi as its dedicated sushi component; the contact page explicitly names the venue 'JACKS PLACE & KUMA SUSHI' and confirms the address and email while supplying a phone number absent from OSM. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, or water refill; the front page 'order now' button confirms takeout; and the sushi and pizza menus contain clearly vegetarian items (avocado roll, tempura yam roll, Margherita and G.O.A.T. pizzas), with a GF beer (Whistler Forager) listed in the drink menu.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists this as 'Kuma Sushi' but the website is for 'Jack's Place', with Kuma Sushi being the integrated sushi component; the contact page identifies the combined venue as 'JACKS PLACE & KUMA SUSHI'.
OSM community field shows 'Victoria' but the address is in Langford, BC — a separate municipality.
OSM has no phone number; (250) 391-5225 was sourced from the website contact page only, so phone contact_confirmed set to null.
The OSM record may be a sub-component of a larger Jack's Place OSM node — worth checking for a duplicate parent record at the same address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, actively operating full-service restaurant at Bear Mountain resort that would serve touring cyclists well. The name discrepancy between the OSM record and the broader establishment is a data-quality issue to flag, not a reason to exclude.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Sushi menu lists avocado roll and tempura yam roll (both vegetarian); pizza menu includes Margherita and The G.O.A.T. (goat cheese, artichokes, tomatoes, spinach) as vegetarian options. Drink menu lists Whistler Forager GF beer as a gluten-free option

wow_evidence: full-service patio restaurant situated at Bear Mountain resort
